about_the_game:
Join the Battle in Nemesis Z | Coop!

Immerse yourself in a thrilling local co-op split-screen experience. Explore a fusion of genres with Third-Person Shooter and First-Person Shooter gameplay, all set in a sci-fi world full of action and adventure.

Key Features:

  • Diverse Battlegrounds: Fight across post-apocalyptic realms and various other breathtaking scenes.

  • Customizable Characters: Personalize and upgrade your player to suit your playstyle.

  • RPG-Style Inventory: Manage your gear, weapons, and more.

  • Limited Ammo: Test your strategy with resource management.

Local Multiplayer Coop:

Enjoy split-screen gameplay with friends for endless cooperative action.

Your Feedback Matters!

We’re eager to hear your thoughts and improve the game. Help us make Nemesis Z even better by sharing your comments and bug reports. Thank you for being part of our journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-8600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5700 or Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-11600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 6700 XT or Nvidia GeForce GTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
